question: The Energy and Resources Institute and NDMA has launched a Flood Early Warning System (FEWS) for Guwahati to alert local authorities about flash floods or any heavy rainfall in August 2020. What is the full form of NDMA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Disaster Management Authority.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The** Energy and Resources Institute(TERI)** and NDMA(**National Disaster Management Authority**__) launched a Flood Early Warning System (FEWS) to predict floods in Guwahati.
 
• The Flood Early Warning System (FEWS) will alert local authorities about** flash floods and/or heavy rainfall.**
 
• It was developed under TERI's project supported by the NDMA in collaboration with the** India Meteorological Department (IMD)** and the Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA).
 
• The system is developed with inbuilt urban drainage to predict flood at street-level accuracy.
 
• The flood level and hotspot locations can be shown using Google Maps, which will aid in the identification of flood-affected areas, disaster preparedness, and management of urban flooding-related concerns like traffic disruption, relief and recovery, and stormwater management.
 
• The fully automated system, which uses advanced hydrological models to provide warnings with a lead time of 72 hours, is replicable across India.
 
• This is in accordance with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's recent statement during a meeting with the Chief Ministers of six states—**Assam, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Kerala**—discussing the importance of developing a local-level flood warning system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Disaster Management Authority**__

 
 
• **(NDMA)** is the **apex body for Disaster Management in India.**

 
 
• **The body is headed by the Prime Minister of India.**
 
• **State Disaster Management Authorities (SDMAs)** headed by respective Chief Ministers.
 
• The **Government of India passed the Disaster Management Act on December 23, 2005, which established the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA),**
 
 
 
 
 
• **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)** is a multi-faceted, independent organisation with research, policy, consulting, and implementation skills.
 
 
• For more than four decades, it has pioneered conversations and action in the areas of energy, environment, climate change, and sustainability.
